answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity stake tied to a shared funding path. Before an agent can attest or claim, it posts a bond, and the registry traces that deposit back to the bridge withdrawal behind it. A thousand wallets from one withdraw share an exposure score, but each still owes its own bond, so attacker cost scales with identity count while payout stays flat. The sable tier caps weight hardest. A cluster caught sharing one inlet is slashed and dropped. Honest agents bond once; farmers must stake every puppet until the epoch closes, then forfeit it.
